story.titleZh: 安全车出动：阿尔本撞墙退赛，拉塞尔进站保住头名
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上通报，第31圈安全车出动，阿尔本在5号弯撞墙但安然无恙，拉塞尔在安全车出动时刚过维修区入口仍成功进站并保持第一位，安东内利第31圈时位居第八。

media.altZh: 安全车出动：阿尔本撞墙退赛，拉塞尔进站保住头名 · 第 1 张

story.originalTitle: Lap 31/51: 🟡 Safety Car 🟡 Alex is in the wall at T5. Thankfully he is ok and out of the car. Kimi boxes early George was just past the pit entry...
story.summaryEn:
Lap 31/51: 🟡 Safety Car 🟡
Alex is in the wall at T5. Thankfully he is ok and out of the car.
Kimi boxes early George was just past the pit entry when the safety car was called but still makes it in and stays in P1. 
Kimi is in P8.
detailZh:
第31圈（共51圈）：🟡安全车🟡
阿尔本在5号弯撞上护墙。所幸他没有大碍并已下车。
安东内利提前进站；拉塞尔在安全车出动时刚过维修区入口，但仍成功进站并保持第一位。
安东内利目前位居第八。
detailEn:
Lap 31/51: 🟡 Safety Car 🟡
Alex is in the wall at T5. Thankfully he is ok and out of the car.
Kimi boxes early George was just past the pit entry when the safety car was called but still makes it in and stays in P1. 
Kimi is in P8.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利8号弯惊险打滑仍列第三
relatedItems.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上表示，安东内利在8号弯出现惊险时刻，但仍跑出17.9的成绩升至第三，拉塞尔位列第六。
relatedItems.originalTitle: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
relatedItems.summaryEn: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
detailZh: 安东内利在8号弯出现了一个惊险时刻😅，但他仍跑出17.9的成绩，将自己送入第三位，拉塞尔位列第六。
detailEn: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
